about: The models this installation wants on its VoiceStudio server. `scripts/voicestudio_models.py restore` installs the ones that are missing. A model with a non-commercial or gated licence is listed here but only installed when a person passes --accept-licences for it.

notes.KittenML/kitten-tts-mini-0.8: English, CPU, 80 MB, commercial category. Installed 2026-10-28; used to prove the chain.
notes.k2-fsa/OmniVoice: 600+ languages, voice cloning and design; CC-BY-NC plus Higgs Audio 2 and Meta Llama 3 tokenizer terms. Listed, not accepted by the agent (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q10).
